notes.title: Accidental Finish Patch
notes.content: Some players were finishing the level without realizing, which meant to collect em' all they needed to restart the level. Now there's a caution message prior to the final hotdog.

notes.title: Community Feedback Quality Improvements
notes.content:
A few small updates based on community feedback:

- Modified the base of the river so hotdogs can't get lost under water (Inspired by TofuPope!)
- Fixed typo in Spanish translation (caught by TofuPope!)
- Improved the way forced camera perspective works in the clover area. Now uses the regular first person mode rather than changing the angle of the third person mode, which can feel unexpected and claustrophobic (thanks for the feedback Zeinstein!)
- Added a soft landing sound and a little wind landing animation to make the character falling feel a bit less weightless. The animation could use a bit more work, but it's a good start. Also increased terminal velocity. (Thanks MapleThunder!)

Enjoy!

notes.title: Quality Settings
notes.content:
Added Quality settings to make the game playable for more folks, and more enjoyable for some people who are already able to play but with lag or weird graphics.
I also updated the menu style for the Options menu to make it more readable.

Please note that playing on low quality settings also increases the look sensitivity.
I'm planning to add look sensitivity settings in a future patch, but for now, play on whichever setting feels the best!

notes.title: Language Update (for Kyle)!
notes.content:
This update adds a few language options to Goblin Hotdogs:

[list]
[*] Français (French)
[*] 中文 (Simplified Chinese)
[*] Русский (Russian)
[*] Español (Spanish)
[*] Português (Portuguese)
[*] Deutsch (German)
[*] 日本語 (Japanese)
[*] Polski (Polish)
[*] 한국어 (Korean)
[/list]

These translations were done using a combination of Google Translate, DeepL (an LLM focused on language translation), and, in the case of French, assisted by my own (limited) bilingual abilities. French was my first choice for inclusion because of my Canadian heritage (et c'est un hommage à mon homme Kyle). The rest of the languages were chosen because they represent the top 10 most popular languages among users on Steam.

There is no speech in any human language within the game. The amount of text in the game is also intentionally minimal, and the plan it to keep it that way even as narrative is added. The menus have been changed to use symbols in some places to further minimize text. The remaining few menu items are where you'll find the translations, as well as in titles, and on the end screen.

There are a few ways that users can change the language:
[list]
[*] In the Options menu, you can click the "Language" button to cycle through all of the supported languages. The available languages are listed within the button, and the active language has a unique border. I realize the layout of this button is a weird design choice, but it allows each language option to be visible with minimal menu layers and risk of players not being able to find the language options if they're trying to navigate the user interface while in a different language.
[*] If the game supports the language of your operating system, the game's language should now be automatically set to that language. Note that if you have changed the language manually in the in-game menu, that will always take priority. 
[/list]

If you're bilingual in any of the supported languages and want to help me out, please check out the translations and send a support email with any corrections you might find!

Cheers!
Jon

notes.title: Jump n' Jitter
notes.content:
Incremental improvement tackling a couple quality issues:

[list]
[*] Players have reported a drop in framerate in some of the forested areas. While I haven't eliminated this issue completely (yet), the issue shouldn't be quite as bad, as I've pruned the forest in the areas that were worst affected.
[*] Goblin no longer does "Bugs Bunny style" mid-air running. lol the right version of this would be cute, but this version wasn't, and the "footsteps" sound mid-air was sloppy rather than fun. Fixed!
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch - Edge Casing
notes.content:
Updates:

[list]
[*] Flattened ground around a couple hotdogs that were reported clipping through the ground (this may only be a partial fix).
[*] Force perspective in the clover grove to give the player the sense they're in the thick of the plants.
[*] QoL around the edges.
[/list]
